title: The explicit affine tilde comparison map for the symmetric algebra
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $W$ an affine open. Put $R=\mathcal O_X(W)$, $A=\operatorname{Sym}_R(F(W))$, and let $S$ be the symmetric algebra ring sheafification with unit $\theta$ [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-sheaf-construction]. Let $\iota_W:\operatorname{Spec}R\to X$ be the affine chart [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-spec-points]. The section unit is $R$-linear, and the tilde adjunction [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction] explicitly constructs $\alpha_W:\widetilde A\to S|_{\operatorname{Spec}R}$ [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits]. Under the explicit linear identification $\Gamma(S|_{\operatorname{Spec}R})\cong S(W)$, $\alpha_{W,\top}\tau_\top=\theta_W$, where $\tau$ is the tilde section map [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections]. On every open $V$ of $\operatorname{Spec}R$, $\alpha_{W,V}\tau_V(a)$ is the restriction of the transported $\theta_W(a)$. No quasi-coherence assumption is needed.

source.place: Schemes, Lemma 01I7 (lemma-compare-constructions); restriction along the canonical affine chart

proof.text: For an affine open W of X, let iota_W : Spec O_X(W) -> X be its canonical chart. Its image of the top open is W. Restriction gives an additive isomorphism from the global sections of G restricted along iota_W to G(W). Give it the O_X(W)-linear structure: transporting a scalar through GammaSpecIso and the chart structure map is restriction of that scalar. The inverse is the inverse restriction on equal opens. This is the existing upstream Scheme.Modules.sectionsTopRestrictFromSpecEquiv, for every module G.

source.place: Schemes, Lemma 01I7 (lemma-compare-constructions); restriction along the canonical affine chart

proof.text: The ring sheafification unit theta_W is O_X(W)-linear: theta_W(r a) = theta_W(algebraMap(r)) theta_W(a), and theta_W(algebraMap(r)) is the structure map of the algebra sheaf. Compose this linear map with the inverse of Scheme.Modules.sectionsTopRestrictFromSpecEquiv for the underlying module of S. Apply the inverse of the tilde adjunction homEquiv to construct alpha_W : tilde(Sym_O(W)(F(W))) -> S restricted to Spec O_X(W). This construction uses no quasi-coherence and no unproved choice of data.

The homEquiv followed by its inverse is the identity. Evaluating this identity at a in the symmetric algebra and applying Scheme.Modules.sectionsTopRestrictFromSpecEquiv gives Scheme.Modules.sectionsTopRestrictFromSpecEquiv(alpha_top(tau_top(a))) = theta_W(a). For any open V of Spec O_X(W), naturality of alpha and tau identifies alpha_V(tau_V(a)) with the restriction of the transported theta_W(a).

source.place: Schemes, Lemma 01I7; naturality of the tilde section map
